description: Creates a user who can be used in WorkMail by calling the RegisterToWorkMail operation.

incidents.description: Threat Actors Using AWS WorkMail in Phishing Campaigns

securityImplications: Attackers might use CreateUser in WorkMail to create mailbox users with business-like addresses that act as phishing senders and give them access that does not depend on IAM.
